name: Sole-Proprietor Bookkeeping & GST/HST Tracker
short: Log income and expenses the way the T2125 asks for them, with your province's sales tax built in.
for: Freelancers, contractors, gig workers and side-hustlers who file a T2125 with their personal return.
problem: Most bookkeeping templates are American. They don't use CRA expense categories, they don't know HST from PST, and they won't tell you when you're getting close to the $30,000 GST/HST registration threshold.
inside: Date, client, amount, GST/HST charged, payment received
Every row tagged with the matching T2125 expense line
GST, HST, PST and QST rates for all provinces and territories
Running total of the last four calendar quarters against $30,000
Totals by T2125 line, ready to copy into your return or hand to an accountant
formats: Google Sheets copy link and an Excel (.xlsx) file
faq: Do I need to be registered for GST/HST to use it?
No. It works for small suppliers who don't charge GST/HST and for registrants who do.
Does it file my taxes?
No. It organizes your records so filing is faster. It isn't tax software or tax advice.

name: Freelancer Invoice Generator with GST/HST
short: Numbered, professional invoices with the right tax line for your province, or none if you're a small supplier.
for: Anyone in Canada who bills clients and wants invoices that look professional without an invoicing subscription.
problem: Free invoice templates rarely handle Canadian sales tax properly: HST in some provinces, GST plus QST in Quebec, and no tax at all for small suppliers.
inside: Your details, client details, line items, automatic numbering
GST, HST and GST + QST, plus a small-supplier mode with no tax line
Every invoice listed with paid or unpaid status
Which invoices are past due and by how many days
formats: Google Sheets copy link and an Excel (.xlsx) file
faq: Can I add my logo?
Yes. There's an image cell at the top of the invoice.
Can I print to PDF?
Yes. The invoice sheet is set up to fit one letter-size page.

name: TFSA / RRSP / FHSA Room Tracker
short: Keep track of contributions against the room CRA says you have, so you don't over-contribute.
for: Canadians saving in more than one registered account who want one place to see what they've used.
problem: Budget apps built for the US don't understand registered accounts, and over-contributing can mean CRA penalties.
inside: Enter the room shown in CRA My Account, log each contribution and withdrawal
TFSA, RRSP and FHSA side by side
Flags when logged contributions pass the room you entered
formats: Google Sheets copy link and an Excel (.xlsx) file
faq: Does it calculate my room for me?
No. Your room depends on your history, so you enter the figure from CRA My Account. The tracker never guesses it.

name: Canadian Household Budget
short: A monthly budget in Canadian dollars with registered-account savings lines built in.
for: Households who want a simple monthly plan that fits Canadian accounts and bills.
problem: Most budget templates assume US accounts and categories.
inside: Income, bills, spending categories and savings in CAD
TFSA, RRSP, FHSA, RESP and emergency fund
formats: Google Sheets copy link and an Excel (.xlsx) file
faq: Can two people use it?
Yes. Share the Google Sheets copy with your partner.

name: Complete Bundle
short: All four tools plus a vehicle and home-office log, for less than buying them separately.
for: Self-employed Canadians who want their business and household money in order at once.
inside: Bookkeeping tracker, invoice generator, room tracker, household budget
Business kilometres by trip with a running business-use percentage
formats: Google Sheets copy links and Excel (.xlsx) files
faq: Do I get future updates?
Yes. Each January's update to rates and limits is free for buyers.

name: All-Access Membership
short: Every Loonie Ledger tool, every January update and any new tools we release, for one monthly price.
for: Anyone who wants the whole kit (bookkeeping, invoicing, registered-account room and household budget) kept current year after year, without buying each tool separately.
problem: CRA rates and limits change every year, and your needs change too. The membership keeps you on the current version of every tool instead of buying them one at a time.
inside: Bookkeeping & GST/HST Tracker, Invoice Generator, TFSA/RRSP/FHSA Room Tracker, Household Budget, and the Vehicle & Home-Office Log
Each year's refreshed rates and limits, sent to members
Any new tool we release while you're a member
$5 a month, or $39 a year. Cancel any time
formats: Google Sheets copy links and Excel (.xlsx) files
faq: How do I cancel?
Log in to your Payhip customer account (the link is in your receipt email), open Settings, then Subscriptions, and click cancel. Or email us and we'll help.
What happens to my files if I cancel?
Files and Google Sheets copies you've already made stay yours to use. You stop getting new tools and updates, and you lose access to the member downloads.
Monthly or yearly?
Yearly works out cheaper ($39 instead of $60). It's the same price as the Complete Bundle, with updates and new tools included.
Is this tax advice?
No. The tools organize your records using CRA categories. They aren't tax software or tax advice.
